root_cause: The govuk-tabs component incorrectly treats ArrowDown and ArrowUp as navigation keys for the tablist, causing focus to move to the next/previous tab on a horizontally oriented tablist, which violates ARIA keyboard guidelines that only left/right arrows should change selection.
repair_strategy: Add a keydown listener to the tablist that prevents the default action for ArrowDown and ArrowUp when the event target is a tab, leaving focus and selection unchanged while preserving left/right navigation.

edits.after:
<script type="module">
import { Tabs } from './packages/govuk-frontend/src/govuk/components/tabs/tabs.js'
const tabsEl = document.getElementById('applications-tabs');
new Tabs(tabsEl);
tabsEl.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
  if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target.matches('[role="tab"]')) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }
});
</script>

expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing ArrowDown or ArrowUp while focus is on a tab will no longer change the selected tab or move focus; the tab remains selected and its panel stays visible, conforming to the expected behavior for a horizontal tablist.
functional_risks: If the tablist were ever used in a vertical orientation, ArrowDown/ArrowUp would be incorrectly ignored, potentially breaking intended navigation.
Preventing default on ArrowDown/ArrowUp could suppress page scrolling when focus is not on a tab, though the listener only acts when the target has role='tab'.
Future updates to the govuk-tabs component might conflict with this listener if it also modifies key handling.
verification_requirements: Verify that after pressing ArrowDown on the Past day tab, focus remains on that tab, aria-selected remains true, and the Past day panel stays visible.
Verify that pressing ArrowUp similarly does not change focus or selection.
Confirm that ArrowRight and ArrowLeft still move focus and selection between tabs as expected.
Ensure that screen reader announcement of the selected tab remains correct after ArrowDown/ArrowUp presses.
